requirements.summary: Accept one public input named query, use Amazon.fr to search for that article, process at most the first 10 products, visit each product page, extract product name, description, and price without inventing missing data, save the results to an Excel workbook at workflows/schema-portability-20261002/canonical20261007b-amazon-1/products.xlsx, and close the browser even on failure.

outcomes.description: Amazon.fr is searched using the provided query input.
Up to the first 10 product results are identified in order from the search results.
For each selected product page, the product name, description, and price are extracted when present; absent price/data and CAPTCHA or blocking are recorded explicitly.
An XLSX workbook is saved to workflows/schema-portability-20261002/canonical20261007b-amazon-1/products.xlsx.
The browser is closed even if navigation, extraction, CAPTCHA, or file creation fails.

tasks.objective: Open Amazon.fr search results for the provided public query.
Determine whether the loaded Amazon.fr page is search results, cookie consent, CAPTCHA/blocking, or another blocker; keep compact observed facts and references only.
If an observed cookie consent control is present, activate it with the observed reference and re-observe the page.
Activate the observed Amazon cookie consent accept/continue control.
Determine whether results are available after cookie consent or whether a CAPTCHA/blocker remains.

From the complete observed search-results snapshot, identify up to the first 10 organic product result links in displayed order; if blocked, return an explicit blocker status and no invented products.
Visit each selected product page in order and extract product name, description, and price; keep absent data explicit and never invent missing fields.
Open the current product page using the extracted absolute href.
Extract the current product page details: name, description, and price; if CAPTCHA/blocking or any field is absent, record that explicitly in status and nullable fields.
Assemble the final product array in original search-result order, or an explicit single blocker row when search results were blocked before product links could be collected.
Create tab-separated spreadsheet content for XLSX generation with columns name, description, price, status; normalize tabs and line breaks inside cell values.
Save the XLSX workbook to the required relative workspace path.

always.objective: Close the browser page and context even if any navigation, extraction, CAPTCHA, or file creation step failed.
